description: Searches 1,008 US template-related keywords (Excel & Google Sheets) by substring. Returns each match with its estimated monthly US search volume (2026), category, and — where one exists — the URL of a free, no-signup template implementation on tabletemplates.com. Example: { "query": "invoice" }.

limit.description: Max results, ordered by search volume (default 15).

query.description: Search text matched against the keyword, e.g. 'budget', 'invoice', 'gantt'.

name: search_templates
title: Search spreadsheet template demand
